Description:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/R4p1FQFD/207679-2.jpg[/img]

[center][b]Perdón por el desorden pero es una partida de testeo y tiene spoilers de la próxima actualización de Nando´s Farm of Tomorrow - C.O.R.E. Labs!
[/b][b][b][size=4]
LA CAMISETA DE ARGENTINA![/size][/b][/b][/center]
[center][size=2]Es un mod simple, permite poder usar la camiseta de argentina (miuy adaptada por obvias razones jaja) mediante Fashiion Sense,[/size][/center]
[size=2]
[b]Contenido del mod[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=2][b]Vanilla [/b]- Camiseta femenina y masculina con y sin numero en la espalda[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Soft Farmer[/b] - Camiseta femenina y masculina con y sin numero en la espalda[/size][/*]
[/list][size=2]
[b]Que es Soft Farmer? [/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]Es un granero suave... Ok no, es un Body Type mod, es decir un mod que permite un estilo de cuerpo, tiene varias opciones:[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Robusto (Así bien macizo como debería ser el granjero)[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Suave (mas delgado)[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Tiene para cuerpos masculino y femeninos, por sii te lo preguntas... Sí, puedes ser una granjera bien robusta si quieres jajaja[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Cuenta con muchas más opciones para personalizar a nuestro avatar... de destrucción, haz clic en[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41768] Soft Farmer [/url]para descargarlo[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Lo olvidaba, tambien hay cvarios complementos para Soft Farmer que se instalan por sepado como orejitas, colas y pieles.[/size][/*]
[/list][size=2]
[b]Requerimientos[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url], obvio[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]SMAPI, obvio[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41768]Sofr Farmer[/url] (Opcional pero muy recomendado)[/size][/*]
[/list][size=2]
[b]Instalación[/b]
Descomprime el archivo y pon el mod en[b][i] stardew valley/mods[/i][/b]

[b]Dato curioso[/b]
Yo soy lo menos furbolero que hay pero me pareció divertido y una forma de conmemorar este deporte que tantas pasiones trae. Por favor, no se pongan intensos en los comentarios, sé que hay ciertos comentarios que se han hecho hacia mi pais en twiutter y no quiero los traigan aquí.[/size]

[center][b][size=3]Gracias [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Crisaius]Crisaius [/url]por hacer el diseño, te quedó genial![/size][/b][/center]
[center]__________________________________[/center]

[center][b][size=4]ENGLISH[/size][/b][/center]

[center][size=2]Sorry for the mess [/size][b][size=2]in[/size][/b][size=2] the screenshot, but this is a test save and it contains spoilers for the upcoming update of [/size][b][size=2]Nando's Farm of Tomorrow - C.O.R.E. Labs[/size][/b][size=2]![/size]
[b][b][size=4]
THE ARGENTINA JERSEY![/size][/b][/b][/center]
[center][size=2]It's a simple mod that allows you to wear the Argentina jersey (heavily adapted for obvious reasons haha) through Fashion Sense.[/size][/center]
[size=2]
[b]Mod Content[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=2][b]Vanilla [/b]- Female and male jersey, with and without a number on the back[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Soft Farmer[/b] - Female and male jersey, with and without a number on the back[/size][/*]
[/list][size=2]
[b]What is Soft Farmer?[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]It's a soft barn... Okay no, it's a Body Type mod, meaning a mod that allows for a different body style. It has several options:[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Robust (Burly, the way a farmer should be)[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Soft (More slender)[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]It has options for both male and female bodies, and in case you're wondering... Yes, you can be a very robust female farmer if you want hahaha[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]It features many more options to customize our avatar... of destruction. Click on Soft Farmer to download it.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]I almost forgot, there are also several add-ons for Soft Farmer that are installed separately, like little ears, tails, and skins.[/size][/*]
[/list][size=2]
[b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]Fashion Sense, obviously[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]SMAPI, obviously[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Soft Farmer (Optional but highly recommended)[/size][/*]
[/list][size=2]
[b]Installation[/b]
Unzip the file and put the mod into stardew valley/mods[/size]
[size=2]
[b]Fun Fact[/b]
I am the least football/scoccer -loving person out there, but I thought this would be fun and a way to commemorate a sport that brings out so much passion. Please, don't get toxic in the comments. I know there are certain comments that have been made towards my country on Twitter, and I don't want them brought here.[/size]
